notes.title: Update 1.13
notes.content:
Hello to all!

With this update, we have added "The Gauntlet" play mode. This mode will take you through all the tunnels, one after the other, without the option to continue if you fall and without making use of the resources you found in story mode. Use only what you collect in that run.

Even more, the resources you collect and will lose if you fall are now shown while warping, so that you know what is at stake. Also, during resource collection runs, a clear message will let you know when you completed a lap and the collected resources are safe.

Due to some performance upgrades we were also able to increase the view range, so you can now plan the route better.

Keep rolling, and let us know your thoughts!
